def: opening (of a dungeon), i.e. jail-delivery (figuratively, salvation for sin)

words.word: and the opening of the prison

occurrences.text: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
